channel.title: World News Live
channel.description: Daily news briefs: geopolitics, tech, sports, entertainment, business and world news, in our own words.

item.title: Trump, Xi and Putin Set for Historic Meeting in Shenzhen as Nuclear Arms and Iran Top the Agenda
item.description: The leaders of the world's three largest nuclear powers are set to meet in Shenzhen next week, with Iran and nuclear arms on the agenda — though officials say no deals are expected.

item.title: Microsoft 365 Outage Enters Second Day as Outlook, Teams and Copilot Slowly Recover
item.description: Microsoft said services were gradually recovering on Friday after a global outage knocked out Outlook, Teams and Copilot for nearly two days, with no firm time given for full recovery.

item.title: India's Exports Jump 29.9% to a Record $89.99 Billion in October as Trade Deficit Narrows
item.description: India's overall exports jumped 29.9% in October to a record $89.99 billion, government data showed, while the trade deficit narrowed to $20.09 billion.

item.title: Scientists Map the Brain's Movement Centre Cell by Cell in a 25.5-Million-Cell Atlas
item.description: Scientists have mapped the brain's movement centre cell by cell, profiling 25.5 million individual cells in a project published across 27 papers.

item.title: New Zealand Thrash India by 244 Runs in Fourth ODI as Matt Henry Takes 6 for 27
item.description: New Zealand thrashed India by 244 runs in the fourth ODI at Mount Maunganui, with Matt Henry taking 6 for 27 after Will Young's century lifted the hosts to 333.

item.title: YouTube Trending Today: O.M Trailer, Chhath Songs and The Weeknd Lead the Charts
item.description: Dhanush and Mammootty's O.M trailer, The Weeknd's Hong Kong video and a Chhath Puja jukebox lead today's YouTube charts in India and the US.

item.title: India's TB Deaths Fall 38% Since 2015, Ahead of the Global Decline, WHO Report Finds
item.description: India's tuberculosis mortality has fallen 38% since 2015, ahead of the global decline of 35%, the WHO's Global Tuberculosis Report 2026 found.

item.title: Consumer Watchdog Fines Ola Rs 10 Lakh Over Pre-Ride 'Tip' Feature, Calls It a Dark Pattern
item.description: The consumer protection authority has fined Ola Rs 10 lakh over a pre-ride 'tip' feature it called a dark pattern.

item.title: Nvidia Chief Jensen Huang Resigns After 33 Years; CFO Colette Kress Takes Over as Interim CEO
item.description: The chipmaker's board announced the resignation on Thursday, ending Huang's three-decade run at the top of the world's most valuable AI company, as shares slid.

item.title: Eight Dead in Brooklyn Building Collapse; Six-Months-Pregnant Woman Pulled Alive From Rubble
item.description: The 1930s three-storey building fell into a neighbouring excavation site on Wednesday afternoon, and rescuers worked through the night as officials said the cause was still under investigation.

item.title: Bengaluru's Pink Line Opens Today as PM Modi Inaugurates Metro Stretch
item.description: The Prime Minister will launch the new line along with projects worth over Rs 15,600 crore in the city, with passenger services starting on Saturday morning.

item.title: US Asks Japan to Triple Spending on Hosting American Troops to Over 3 Trillion Yen
item.description: The Trump administration's demand, reported on Thursday, would raise Tokyo's five-year host-nation support bill sharply from fiscal 2027.

item.title: India U19s Storm Into Asia Cup Final After Crushing Afghanistan; Pakistan Await on Saturday
item.description: India won their semi-final by eight wickets in Oman and will meet arch-rivals Pakistan in the final on 14 November.

item.title: ISRO Completes Ground Static Test of PSLV's Third Stage
item.description: The test fires the rocket stage while it is held firmly on the ground, checking that it performs exactly as designed before it ever flies.

item.title: Delhi's Air Fight: Stubble-Burning Checks Ordered as Cloud Seeding Awaits IIT Kanpur Report
item.description: The air-quality panel has told Punjab districts to verify stubble-burning sites after a rise in incidents, while Delhi's cloud-seeding trials depend on the institute's findings.

item.title: YouTube Trending Today: The Weeknd's Hong Kong, Pixar's Gatto and GTA 6 Lead the Charts
item.description: Music and gaming dominate the charts, with The Weeknd's new video at number one in the US, a Pixar trailer close behind, and a Bhojpuri Chhath song topping India.

item.title: US Envoys Meet Putin in Moscow After Abu Dhabi Talks Agree Prisoner Swap
item.description: Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner arrived in Moscow for talks with Vladimir Putin, a day after two days of US-mediated negotiations in Abu Dhabi produced agreement on a prisoner exchange but no breakthrough on a ceasefire or territory.

item.title: AIMIM and Azad Samaj Party Join Hands for 2027 Uttar Pradesh Polls
item.description: Asaduddin Owaisi's AIMIM and Chandrashekhar Azad's Azad Samaj Party (Kanshiram) have announced an alliance for the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, with Azad set to lead the front.

item.title: 4,000-Year-Old Rock Paintings Discovered in Tamil Nadu's Karadimalai Hills
item.description: Red ochre rock paintings estimated to be around 4,000 years old have been found in the Karadimalai hills of Villupuram district, Tamil Nadu.

item.title: US on the Brink of Losing Measles Elimination Status, Health Officials Say
item.description: The United States is likely to lose its measles elimination status as a regional World Health Organization body meets, though the CDC says its response to the disease is unchanged.
